scripts.text: - You are carrying too many items! -
I can feel a strange force growing stronger and stronger, somewhere in Midgard.
scripts.translation: .我感觉到米德加尔特某处有一股奇怪的力量正在不断增强。

scripts.text: I'm waiting for the day when I'll finally get to see Thor's thunder for myself. I believe that one of these days, my dream will become reality.
scripts.translation: 我一直在等着亲眼见识托尔的雷霆。 / 我相信，总有一天梦想会成真。

scripts.text: In exchange for the ores that you have brought me, I will give you one of my family treasures.
scripts.translation: ！作为对你带来矿石的回报，我会送你一件家传宝物。

scripts.text: You have two options in choosing a treasure. You can have a treasure that will be useful to yourself, or something that may suit one of your friends.
scripts.translation: 宝物有两种选法：挑一件自己用得上的，或是挑一件适合朋友的。

scripts.text: An item that I can use.
An item that my friend can use.
I seem to recall that I put it somewhere around... Hmm.
Once again, I thank you for the trouble you've gone through on my behalf. I'm unsure of how this works, but I hope it will be useful to you. From what I know, I believe this is a rare item.
scripts.translation: 再次感谢你替我奔波。这东西怎么用，我也不清楚，不过希望能帮到你。据我所知，它应该很稀有。

scripts.text: I'll be waiting for the day when I'll see Thor's thunder for myself. I believe that the dream I've had will come true, one of these days.
scripts.translation: 我会一直等到亲眼见识托尔的雷霆。 / 我相信，我的梦想总有一天会实现。

scripts.text: I don't have much time, so go ahead and continue on your journeys if you can't bring those to me.
scripts.translation: 我时间不多，如果你无法把这些带给我，就请继续你的旅程吧。

scripts.text: I sense a strange energy growing more powerful somewhere on this continent...
scripts.translation: 我感觉到这片大陆的某处有一股奇怪的能量正在变得更强...
一定有什么事要发生了！

scripts.text: I think we'd better wait and see what's happening. Someone will deliver the news to us. Though, I am unsure of whether or not it will be good news or bad...
scripts.translation: 我想，还是先等等，看发生了什么。总会有人带来消息，只是不知道会是喜讯，还是噩耗...

scripts.text: You've met the four Dwarven Blacksmiths. I've heard that they rarely speak to humans. So you must be special if you were able to talk to them.
scripts.translation: 你见到了四位矮人铁匠？听说他们很少跟人类说话。能让他们开口，你一定很特别。

scripts.text: Do you think that my dream will come true? Do you believe Thor's Mjolnir will appear before the eyes of humans? I'm afraid great change will come to this world.
scripts.translation: 你说，我的梦想会实现吗？托尔的雷神之锤，真的会出现在人类面前吗？恐怕这个世界要发生巨变了。

scripts.text: Thank you for going through such trouble on my behalf. I wish to give you one of my family treasures as a token of my gratitude.
scripts.translation: 谢谢你为我费心。我想送你一件家传宝物，以表谢意。

scripts.text: However, I hope you understand that my family would grow suspicious if one of the treasures were to just go missing.
scripts.translation: 不过，希望你能理解，如果一件宝物突然失踪，我的家人肯定会起疑心。

scripts.text: Hmm, however, I don't think they'll complain if I exchanged one of the treasures for something else. Let me think...
scripts.translation: 嗯，不过如果他们知道我是用一件宝物换了别的东西，应该就不会抱怨了。让我想想...

scripts.text: I should be able to give you
one of our family heirlooms if you can bring be 50 Rough Oridecons and 50 Rough Eluniums.
scripts.translation: 神之金属原石和50个铝原石，我就可以送你一件家传宝物。

scripts.text: You don't have to do that if you don't want to. But it seems our family heirlooms would be more useful to an adventurer such as yourself...
scripts.translation: 如果你不愿意，也可以不做。但看来这些家传宝物对你这样的冒险者更有用...

scripts.text: must be upset at you for
By this time, they've probably forgotten the insult. But make sure you speak to my sister for advice first.
scripts.translation: 了。到这个时候，他们大概已经忘了那件事。但记得先去找我姐姐问问建议。

scripts.text: I sense a strange energy growing more powerful somewhere on this continent...

一定有什么事要发生了！

scripts.text: One of my ancestors supposedly was a servant of Thor. Still, I find it difficult to believe.
scripts.translation: 据说，我有位祖先曾经是托尔的仆人。不过，这实在很难相信。

scripts.text: If the gods have all these powers, how could a mere human be of any real assistance?
scripts.translation: 如果众神拥有如此强大的力量，区区人类又能帮上什么忙呢？

scripts.text: Last night, I had the most amazing dream where I was the servant of Thor, god of thunder.
scripts.translation: 昨晚，我做了一个不可思议的梦，梦里我是雷神托尔的仆人。

scripts.text: with Thor to Jotunnheim, land of giants. During our journey, he told me many interesting stories about gods and heroes.
scripts.translation: 尔前往巨人国度约顿海姆。旅途中，他给我讲了许多关于众神和英雄的有趣故事。

scripts.text: Of course, I can't remember everything clearly, but it was truly fantastic.
scripts.translation: 当然，我记不清所有细节，但那真的非常精彩。

scripts.text: For some reason, I can vividly recall what Thor told me about his weapon, Mjolnir. Mjolnir is a Dwarven masterpiece.
scripts.translation: 不知为什么，托尔谈起武器雷神之锤时说的话，我却记得清清楚楚。那可是矮人的杰作。

scripts.text: Thor told me that Dwarves are extremely talented artisans, and their works are supreme. So as
scripts.translation: 托尔说，矮人是天赋非凡的工匠，作品举世无双。回想起

scripts.text: I was thinking about my dream,
has the same name as Thor's
I've also recently heard a rumor that Dwarven Blacksmiths also reside on Mount Mjolnir.
scripts.translation: 最近我还听到一个传闻，说矮人铁匠也住在妙勒尼山脉上。

scripts.text: I understand the mountain is dangerous, and that I'm in no position to ask such a thing...
scripts.translation: 我知道那座山很危险，我也知道我不该提出这样的要求...

scripts.text: I can't help wanting to know for myself whether or not there is truth to my dream. Is it possible for Mjolnir to resurface?
scripts.translation: 我实在想知道，这个梦到底有没有依据。雷神之锤真的有可能重现于世吗？

scripts.text: If you don't mind, I'd like to ask you to explore this mountain and search for these Dwarven Blacksmiths.
scripts.translation: 如果不介意的话，我想请你探索这座山，寻找这些矮人铁匠。

scripts.text: I see. But I still appreciate that you took the time to listen to me.
scripts.translation: 我明白了。但我还是很感激你愿意花时间听我倾诉。

scripts.text: Hopefully someday I'll learn the truth about my dreams and about Mjolnir itself.
scripts.translation: 希望有一天我能弄清我梦境的真相，以及雷神之锤本身的秘密。

scripts.text: Even though it won't be easy, I have faith that if the Dwarven Blacksmiths do exist, you'll be able to find them.
scripts.translation: 了！虽然不容易，但我相信，只要那些矮人铁匠确实存在，你就一定能找到他们。

scripts.text: Oh, and please speak to my sister Roskva first. She is outside the North Entrance of Prontera.
scripts.translation: 哦，对了，请先去和我姐姐罗丝克瓦对话。她在普隆德拉北门外面。

scripts.text: give you useful information if you're fortunate enough to encounter the Dwarves.
scripts.translation: 你一些有用的事，让你有幸遇到矮人时，知道该怎么做。

scripts.text: I'm truly lucky to meet such an adventurer like yourself. I wish you the best of luck.
scripts.translation: 能遇到像你这样的冒险者，我真的很幸运。祝你一路顺风。

scripts.text: You should know that Dwarven Blacksmiths are extremely offended if you do not speak to them with the utmost respect.
scripts.translation: 矮人铁匠非常看重礼数。跟他们说话，要是有半点不敬，他们可是会发怒的。

scripts.text: The first Dwarf you must visit
can be found to the East.
Travel in a clock wise direction around Midgard and seek out the other Dwarves in order. Your final destination will be to the North.
scripts.translation: 请沿顺时针方向绕米德加尔特行进，按顺序寻找其他矮人。你的最终目的地在北方。

scripts.text: If you happen to speak to them in the wrong order, please go talk to my brother Tialfi again.
scripts.translation: 要是不小心弄错了拜访顺序，就再回去找提亚尔菲吧。

can be found to the North.

scripts.translation: 请沿逆时针方向绕米德加尔特行进，按顺序寻找其他矮人。你的最终目的地在东方。

scripts.text: A long time ago, many people used to frequent this area. Friends and families would live here, sharing happiness and sadness.
scripts.translation: 很久以前，这一带常有人来往。亲朋好友住在这里，有福同享，有难同当。

scripts.text: But they're all gone now. My parents and my friends have all gone to a place whose name I don't even know.
scripts.translation: 但现在他们都走了。我的父母和朋友们都去了一个我甚至不知道名字的地方。

scripts.text: Something is happening somewhere on this continent. You might not believe me, but I keep getting visions of the Fenrir-Wolf.
scripts.translation: 这片大陆的某处正在发生着什么。你可能不信，但我不断看到芬里尔之狼的幻象。

scripts.text: Something is happening somewhere on this continent. You might not believe me, but I keep getting visions of the Fenrir-Wolf.
scripts.translation: 这片大陆的某处正在发生着什么。你可能不信，但我不断看到芬里尔之狼的幻象。

scripts.text: When my people finally retrieve the memories of their past, we will be able to grant the power of the gods to humans.
scripts.translation: 当我的族人最终找回过去的记忆时，我们将能够赋予人类神的力量。

scripts.text: Hm? I sense that you were asked to do a favor for that human. If I were you, I'd finish that task as soon as I could. Somehow, that human's fate, as well as that of the Dwarves, are intertwined...
scripts.translation: 嗯？感觉是那个人类请你来帮忙的。换作是我，就尽快把事情办妥。不知为何，那个人类的命运，竟跟我们矮人紧紧相连...

scripts.text: What is it?! I refuse to speak to human as rude and contemptible
scripts.translation: 什么？！你这种粗鲁可鄙的人类，我没什么好

scripts.text: as you! Now, get out of my sight!
Ah, I see that the entire human race is not worthy of scorn. Unlike many of your kind, I see that you respect your elders.
scripts.translation: 啊，原来人类也不全都令人鄙夷。和你许多同类不同，你倒是懂得尊敬长者。

scripts.text: The hammer than can shake the earth and tear the sky asunder? Out of all of legendary weapons, Mjolnir is perhaps greatest.
scripts.translation: 把传说中的武器？能撼动大地、撕裂天空的神锤？诸般传奇兵器里，它或许当属第一。

scripts.text: As a matter of fact, it was forged by my ancestor. Mjolnir was the perfect weapon, except for one minor flaw.
scripts.translation: 实不相瞒，那是我祖先打造的。除了一个小小的缺陷，雷神之锤堪称完美。

scripts.text: The hilt of Mjolnir was forged shorter than intended. Are you still listening to me?
scripts.translation: 锤柄比原本打算的短了些。你还在听吗？

scripts.text: One day, Loki came to our village and showed off his treasures. He boasted that we couldn't possibly create something to surpass their quality.
scripts.translation: 有一天，洛基来到我们的村庄，炫耀他的宝物。他吹嘘我们不可能创造出超越它们品质的东西。

scripts.text: made by another Dwarf tribe, but we couldn't tolerate his insult. So my ancestors created three treasures of their own.
scripts.translation: 是另一支矮人部族打造的，可我们受不了这份羞辱。于是，祖先们又打造出了三件宝物。

scripts.text: Of the three treasures my ancestors created, Mjolnir was the last and greatest.
scripts.translation: 三件宝物里，雷神之锤最后问世，也最为出色。

scripts.text: However, while it was created, a strange fly bit my ancestor on the hand. Because of this interruption, Mjolnir's hilt is a little flawed.
scripts.translation: 可是打造时，一只怪异的苍蝇叮了我祖先的手。就因为这一下，锤柄才留下了瑕疵。

scripts.text: It's very sad. Although Mjolnir is the greatest weapon ever, it was very close to being the epitome of craftsmanship.
scripts.translation: 实在遗憾。它虽然已是世上最强的武器，却只差一点，就能成为锻造技艺的完美典范。

scripts.text: Despite this minor flaw, Mjolnir is still considered the greatest of legendary weapons.
scripts.translation: 尽管有这个小瑕疵，雷神之锤仍被视为传奇武器中最伟大的。

scripts.text: Mjolnir was the trusted weapon Thor wielded on the battlefield, and every giant feared its power.
scripts.translation: 雷神之锤是托尔在战场上信赖的武器，每一个巨人都畏惧它的力量。

scripts.text: I must say, a Blacksmith's greatest pride comes when he creates the weapon and armor that can be considered his life's work.
scripts.translation: 要我说，铁匠最大的骄傲，就是打造出足以代表自己毕生心血的武器和防具。

scripts.text: The reason this mountain is called Mount Mjolnir is because it was actually created by the hammer.
scripts.translation: 这座山之所以叫妙勒尼山脉，是因为它实际上是由这把锤子创造的。

scripts.text: In a battle against demons a thousand years ago, Thor struck the earth with Mjolnir. The impact caused the ground to rise, creating this mountain.
scripts.translation: 在一千年前与恶魔的战斗中，托尔用雷神之锤击打大地。冲击使地面隆起，形成了这座山。

scripts.text: However, humans can never hope to see or even wield Mjolnir. Only a god can handle that kind of force.
scripts.translation: 人类连亲眼见它都别指望，更别说挥动它了。那样的力量，唯有神能驾驭。

scripts.text: Hmm... But perhaps an ambitious dwarf can forge something similar to Mjolnir so that it can actually be used by humans. It would have less power, but it'd be perfectly crafted.
scripts.translation: 嗯...但也许有志气的矮人，能打造一件类似的武器，供人类使用。威力会弱些，做工却能完美无缺。

scripts.text: a Mjolnir suited to humans. Still, it wouldn't be very easy.
scripts.translation: 合人类的雷神之锤。不过，这并不容易。

scripts.text: Well, I happened to speak much longer than I intended. But I hope you learned what you wished to
scripts.translation: 不知不觉，竟说了这么久。不过，你想知道的雷神之锤的事，应该也

scripts.text: I feel that a great change is coming. I do not know what kind

scripts.text: of effect it will have on our world, but something important will happen...
scripts.translation: 我们的世界产生什么影响，但重要的事情将会发生...

scripts.text: Perhaps only the gods can be
sure as to what the future will bring. In any case, we must prepare ourselves for what will happen.
scripts.translation: 未来会带来什么。无论如何，我们必须为即将发生的事情做好准备。

scripts.text: If you wish to learn more, you should speak to my brothers.
scripts.translation: 如果你想了解更多，应该去和我的兄弟们对话。

scripts.text: You're not listening, are you?! What a waste of my time!
scripts.translation: .！你根本没在听，对不对？！白白浪费我的时间！

scripts.text: This is why I don't want to associate with humans. They always shut me out when I'm talking!
scripts.translation: 这就是为什么我不想和人类打交道。我说话的时候他们总是不听！

scripts.text: wish to prove to me that you understand blacksmiths, you should bring something related to my work!
scripts.translation: 证明你了解铁匠，就带件跟我这门行当有关的东西来！

scripts.text: A respectable blacksmith cherishes his tools and crafts with diligence and care.
scripts.translation: 值得尊敬的铁匠，都会爱惜工具，做工认真仔细。

scripts.text: When it comes to humans, I believe the ones who can appreciate my line of work are the only ones worth talking to.
scripts.translation: 就人类而言，我认为只有那些能欣赏我这一行的人，才值得交谈。

scripts.text: Every good blacksmith knows the value of a good hammer. If you can understand that, I shall consider speaking with you.
scripts.translation: 每一位优秀的铁匠都知道一把好锤子的价值。如果你能理解这一点，我会考虑与你对话。

scripts.text: What made you come to me?
A respectable blacksmith cherishes his tools and crafts with diligence and care.
scripts.translation: 值得尊敬的铁匠，都会爱惜工具，做工认真仔细。

scripts.text: When it comes to humans, I believe the ones who can appreciate my line of work are the only ones worth talking to.
scripts.translation: 就人类而言，我认为只有那些能欣赏我这一行的人，才值得交谈。

scripts.text: Every good blacksmith knows the value of a good hammer. If you can understand that, I shall consider speaking with you.
scripts.translation: 每一位优秀的铁匠都知道一把好锤子的价值。如果你能理解这一点，我会考虑与你对话。

scripts.text: It feels like today's going to be a great day.
I've got the warm sun, fresh forest air, and my hammer and anvil are at the ready. It's a perfect day for smithing!
scripts.translation: 阳光暖和，林间空气清新，锤子和铁砧也都齐备。正是打铁的好日子！

scripts.text: and fight with stronger and stronger opponents!

scripts.translation: 总有一天，我要回斯瓦塔法海姆，打败伊瓦尔迪！哇哈哈哈！

scripts.text: Something that has been hidden is about to be born out of the sweat of determination and tears of sacrifice. We must wait until then.

scripts.text: I want to compete with a stronger one!

scripts.text: I will be stronger and stronger,
scripts.translation: 还要不断变强，总有一天

scripts.text: Go back to where you belong before I beat you to death!

scripts.text: All you can gain here are a few herbs.

scripts.text: Mwahahaha! I'm satisfied with the results. I may have lost, but we fought honorably with everything we had.

scripts.translation: 一对一较量，就得豁出一切，让对手见识自己的力量。

scripts.translation: 人类，你也有过这样的感觉吗？不论胜负，只要倾尽全力，就是最大的满足。

scripts.text: If you want something, you should earn it through your own efforts.
scripts.translation: 如果你想要什么，就应该靠自己的努力去争取。

scripts.text: No matter what other people say, if you're confident and your will is unwavering, you'll always be satisfied with the results.
scripts.translation: 不管别人说什么，只要相信自己、意志坚定，就一定能坦然接受结果。

scripts.text: Someone must have forged something really monstrous, otherwise I wouldn't be feeling so worthless!
scripts.translation: 一定是有人锻造出了惊世之作，不然我怎么会觉得自己这么没用！

scripts.text: Yeah, I think I need a break! Don't you think I need a break, human?
scripts.translation: 是啊，我觉得我需要休息一下！你不觉得我也该休息一下吗，人类？

scripts.text: There's nothing like taking a relaxing break after putting your heart into your work.

Oh, this is excellent! This piece here has been perfectly refined! But this isn't what I want. I can't do any work on this at all.

scripts.text: Blacksmith work on that kind of stuff! Now, a Dwarf like me needs something that's more of a challenge!
scripts.translation: 找人类铁匠做吧！像我这样的矮人，需要的是更有挑战性的工作！

scripts.text: Don't insult me by expecting me to work on anything less than a Level 4 weapon.
scripts.translation: ...别拿4级以下的武器来侮辱我。

scripts.text: Bring me a Level 4 weapon for me to work on next time, got it?

scripts.text: I sense change in the winds, but what that change may be, I cannot tell.
scripts.translation: ？我感觉到风中有变化，但具体是什么变化，我还说不清。

scripts.text: Should I go into the cave to figure it out? Huh. This is most peculiar.
scripts.translation: 我该去洞穴里弄清楚吗？嗯。这真是奇怪。

scripts.text: Even the gods know that we Dwarves are the most talented of artisans! Maybe it doesn't seem that way now, but someday we shall return.
scripts.translation: ！连神都知道，我们矮人是最优秀的工匠！如今也许不显眼，总有一天我们会重归辉煌。

scripts.text: It's nice being in the Mjolnir Forest. To be surrounded by the quiet, peaceful air and not having to worry about anything...

scripts.text: Shouldn't you be on your way by now? Eh, it's none of my business.

scripts.translation: 实际上，托尔被骗了，击败他的对手其实并不是

scripts.text: actually a giant. Illusion was used to disguise Thor's opponent, but I forget was it was. Do you know?
scripts.translation: 巨人。对手是用幻术伪装出来的，但我忘了那是什么了。你知道吗？

scripts.text: Yes, only a Blaze could have effortlessly consumed meat, bones and plates by burning. Of course!
scripts.translation: 没错，只有烈焰，才能轻易把肉、骨头和盘子全都烧个干净。对，就是这样，

scripts.text: The next contest was a race. In that match, Thor's servant, Tialfi competed with the king's servant, Hugi. However, no matter how many matches they had, Hugi would win every time.
scripts.translation: 第二项比赛是赛跑。在那场比赛中，托尔的仆人提亚尔菲与国王的仆人胡基进行了较量。然而，无论比了多少次，胡基总是获胜。

scripts.text: used to disguise the competitor. Do you know what Tialfi was really racing against?
scripts.translation: 用幻术伪装出来的。你知道提亚尔菲实际上在和谁赛跑吗？

scripts.text: Yes, right! Tialfi was racing 'thoughts!' Nothing can move faster than the speed of thought, so it's no wonder Tialfi would always lose.
scripts.translation: 对，提亚尔菲是在跟“思想”赛跑！什么也快不过念头，难怪他总是输。

scripts.text: For the final contest, Thor would challenge an old woman in a wrestling match. At first, Thor thought his victory was assured, but he learned that he could not defeat the old crone.
scripts.translation: 最后一项比赛，托尔要与一位老妇人进行摔跤。起初，托尔以为胜券在握，但他发现根本无法击败这位老妪。

scripts.text: Once again, Thor was the victim
of illusion magic. He didn't realize he wasn't actually wrestling with an old woman. Do you know what his opponent really was?
scripts.translation: 术。他并没有意识到自己实际上并不是在和一位老妇人摔跤。你知道他的对手真正是什么吗？

scripts.text: Yes, Thor was wrestling with 'Old Age!' No matter how strong anybody is, you can't fight against aging.
scripts.translation: 没错，托尔是在和“衰老”摔跤！无论一个人多么强壮，都无法战胜衰老。

scripts.text: the king told him the truth about the contests. Thor grew furious, but it was too late. The king and the giants all vanished by then.
scripts.translation: 赛后，国王告诉他了比赛的真相。托尔勃然大怒，但为时已晚。国王和巨人们全都消失了。

scripts.text: to be learned from this tale. First, don't believe everything you see. Second, never be overconfident of your own power.
scripts.translation: 个道理。第一，眼见未必为实。第二，永远别对自己的力量过分自信。

scripts.text: There will always be someone or something more powerful than you. It is important to always do your best and have an attitude of humility.
scripts.translation: 总会有比你更强大的人或事物存在。保持谦逊的态度，并始终尽力而为，这一点很重要。

scripts.text: Try to live as good a life as you can. Remember that you can't have everything that you want. Obssession and irrationality go hand in hand.
scripts.translation: 尽力做个好人吧，也要记住，不是什么想要的东西都能得到。执念太深，就容易失去理智。

scripts.text: Thank you for listening to my long story. If you meet someone with a dangerous obsession, please tell this story of Thor and the illusions of the giant king.
scripts.translation: 谢谢你耐心听我讲完。若遇到有人执迷不悟，眼看就要走上险路，就给他讲讲托尔和巨人王幻术的故事吧。

scripts.text: I don't think that's right. Let me think, maybe I can remember it. Hopefully, it'll come to me sooner or later...
scripts.translation: ..？好像不对。让我想想，兴许慢慢就能记起来...

scripts.text: Shall we talk more of this once again after enjoying another Red Potion? Hahahahaha~
scripts.translation: 要不，等我再喝瓶红色药水，咱们接着聊？哈哈哈哈哈~

scripts.text: Hm, didn't I ask you to bring a Red Potion? There's no way I can tell any stories with such a dry throat~
scripts.translation: 嗯，我不是让你带红色药水来吗？嗓子这么干，我没法讲故事啊~

scripts.text: Odd. Recently, too many humans have been interested in meeting with me and my brothers. Still, I cannot say their visits have been unpleasant.
scripts.translation: 奇怪。最近有太多人类想见我和我的兄弟们了。不过，我也不能说他们的来访不愉快。

scripts.text: I'm a little thirsty. Would you bring me a Red Potion. If you do that for me, I will tell you an important story. Heh heh heh~
scripts.translation: 有点渴，能带瓶红色药水来吗？作为回报，我给你讲个重要的故事。嘿嘿嘿~

scripts.text: It's nice being in the Mjolnir Forest. To be surrounded by the quiet, peaceful air and not having to worry about anything...
scripts.translation: 待在妙勒尼森林里，真是舒服。四周安静祥和，什么也不用操心...

scripts.text: Shouldn't you be on your way by now? Eh, it's none of my business.
scripts.translation: 你不该早就出发了吗？嗯，这也不是我的事。

scripts.text: If you have the Zeny to spare, why don't you buy some snacks for your travels? Perhaps some delicious Bananas, or even some Pumpkins...
scripts.translation: 如果你有多余的Zeny，为什么不买点路上的零食呢？也许是一些美味的香蕉，甚至是南瓜...

scripts.text: There is a story of a Dwarf named Alvis who contained more knowledge than a library and was braver than Siegfried the warrior.
scripts.translation: 有个故事，讲的是矮人阿尔维斯。他的知识比一整座图书馆还丰富，勇气更胜战士齐格飞。

scripts.text: He fell in love with Thrud, Thor's first daughter, at first sight.
scripts.translation: 心了。他一见托尔的大女儿特鲁德就爱上了她。

scripts.text: He asked Thor for permission to marry Thrud, but as was expected, Thor refused. Alvis should have given up there, but he didn't.
scripts.translation: 他向托尔请求娶特鲁德，但不出所料，托尔拒绝了。阿尔维斯本该就此放弃，但他没有。

scripts.text: So Thor decided to test his knowledge by asking him some questions. The first question was, 'What is the name of the ground in human terms?' Do you know the answer?
scripts.translation: 于是托尔决定通过提问来测试他的知识。第一个问题是：“用人类的语言来说，大地的名字是什么？”你知道答案吗？

scripts.text: Yes, that's right, 'Earth.' Alvis was able to also answer Thor's question correctly.
scripts.translation: 没错，“大地”。阿尔维斯也答对了这一问。

scripts.text: Thor then gave Alvis another question. What is the giant's term for the round shell that covers the earth?
scripts.translation: 接着，托尔又问了他一个问题。在巨人的语言中，覆盖大地的圆形外壳叫什么？

scripts.text: That's it, 'High House.' Since the giants are so huge, it might have looked that way to them.
scripts.translation: 没错，是“高屋”。因为巨人非常巨大，所以在他们看来可能就是这样。

scripts.text: So Thor gave him another question. What is the term for the ball that rises in the sky at night, as used by the gods?
scripts.translation: 于是托尔又问了他一个问题。在众神的语言中，夜晚升上天空的球体叫什么？

scripts.text: Although Alvis answered all of Thor's questions, he didn't notice the sun was rising.
scripts.translation: 然阿尔维斯回答了托尔的所有问题，但他没有注意到太阳正在升起。

scripts.text: Thor prolonged his test so that Alvis would be turned to stone
scripts.translation: ...托尔故意把问答拖得很长，就是要等到日出，让阿尔

scripts.text: from this story. First, do not covet something to the point of challenging fate or the gods.
scripts.translation: 。第一，不要为了贪求某样东西，连命运和神都敢挑战。

scripts.text: Secondly, do not have too much pride in yourself. No matter how much ability or talent you may have, you cannot get everything
scripts.translation: 第二，不要过于自负。无论你的能力或天赋有多高，你都无法得到你想要的一

scripts.text: good and virtuous life. It's great to achieve your desires, but be aware that some desires are not meant to be fulfilled.
scripts.translation: 是善良正直。能实现心愿当然很好，可有些愿望，注定不能成真。

scripts.text: Thank you for listening to my long story. If you meet anyone afflicted with an insatiable desire, please tell him this story of Thor and Alvis, a brave yet very defiant Dwarf.
scripts.translation: 谢谢你耐心听完。若遇到有人欲壑难填，就把托尔和阿尔维斯的故事讲给他听吧。那个矮人虽勇敢，却也太过桀骜。

scripts.text: I don't think that's right. Let me think, maybe I can remember it. Hopefully, it'll come to me sooner or later...
scripts.translation: ..？好像不对。让我想想，兴许慢慢就能记起来...

scripts.text: Shall we talk more of this once again after enjoying another Red Potion? Hahahahaha~
scripts.translation: 要不，等我再喝瓶红色药水，咱们接着聊？哈哈哈哈哈~

scripts.text: Hm, didn't I ask you to bring a Red Potion? There's no way I can tell any stories with such a dry throat~
scripts.translation: 嗯，我不是让你带红色药水来吗？嗓子这么干，我没法讲故事啊~

scripts.text: Odd. Recently, too many humans have been interested in meeting with me and my brothers. Still, I cannot say their visits have been unpleasant.
scripts.translation: 奇怪。最近有太多人类想见我和我的兄弟们了。不过，我也不能说他们的来访不愉快。

scripts.text: I'm a little thirsty. Would you bring me a Red Potion. If you do that for me, I will tell you an important story. Heh heh heh~
scripts.translation: 有点渴，能带瓶红色药水来吗？作为回报，我给你讲个重要的故事。嘿嘿嘿~

scripts.text: I am in charge of this Northern part of Mount Mjolnir. If you wish to pass, you must first secure my approval!
scripts.translation: 我负责妙勒尼山脉北部的守卫工作。如果你想通过，必须先得到我的批准！
